rendered: The BA@HGNRs probe was prepared from CTAB-stabilized HGNRs in the surface-modification step (Section 2.3[1]). In the first centrifugation the HGNRs were centrifuged (6800 rpm, 10 min)[2] and redispersed in KOH solution (pH 11[3]). After incubation with the 4-MPBA[4] solution, the mixture was centrifuged at 3600[5] rpm for 10 min[6], then resuspended and concentrated in 160 μL of[7] 10 mM NH4HCO3[8] to give the BA@HGNRs probes. Summary: the speeds were 6800[9] rpm (first spin) and 3600[10] rpm (second spin), and each spin lasted 10[11] min.
